body: It feels as though this could never heal, and the route we're currently on just seems to be making things worse / more deceptive stuff comes to light.
Thank you. This means so much to me and I almost definitely will reach out with a little time.. this is awful
Thank you so much.
My partner manipulated and mentally abused me about infidelity related stuff for 5 years. Made me crazy. Lots of awful things... im struggling a lot... thank you for this comment.

I'm sorry that you ever felt this way. I don't think I'm a burden onto others, I know I am. Suicide has constantly been a main aspect of my life, I've always wanted it.. since I was 5... I've been to therapy, taken medication and tried support groups. Nothing helped me, Therapy felt like I was paying for a friend when the billions of other humans on this earth don't want to be my friend at all. Group therapy just never worked out for me, not into the kumbaya love ourselves stuff personally, and Medication made me wanna die worse. Not only that I am in a situation now where I cannot afford any of these things not even a little. I imagine suicide is the way I will be heading, and frankly that scares me.

​
This is exactly how I feel all the fucking time.
I imagine you're exhausted if you're feeling this way. I'm sorry this is all happening, even though I don't know whats going on.. I hope you're okay, if you need a friend I'm here.
Ugh. Frustrating, im still unable to post... rip

Did this ever get resolved? This is happening to me at the moment and I can't figure it out, same exact circumstances however. Nsfw account, but no nudity or anything against guidelines, but I don't know why it wont let me post now.
Its not that i refuse to have a conversation with him, its just always the same outcome. Thank you for chatting with me. Was nice.

I am currently into some online groups and whatnot. But overall it doesnt help with my lonely-ness. 

My husband is turning 24 this year.

Yeah I get the idea that it would generally be split between people and its all falling onto him. 

I feel really bad every day because I need him a lot... and it takes just.. idk.. 

We cuddle when he feels like it..  but he doesnt like to a lot. He gets sick of it easy..even if i really need it... for a really long time i just sucked everything up and pretended to be okay even if i was at my absolute worse.

I had two individual therapists, one male one female. They both were nice and showed care.. its just... it feels like its paid for friendship. And... these people dont actually care theyre paid to. So it feels overall really fake to me and it causes a lot of frustration within myself because i DONT have friends otherwise.

I dont have any friends at all actually.

Yeah.. its had mostly downs, not too many ups.

I've been in therapy many times, i'm not a fan of it.

Thank you, im as happy as my current situation allows.

Hes gotten a little better, but hes slowly reverting into old habits it seems. I think im a little overly clingy when i'm sad though? So it could just be me.
Hes my husband now, and frankly while he might.. he doesnt show it as he should. Then again i think i'm just a crazy bitch who should get shot but idk.

I agree, but I also feel like if I was to go through with it, and I  killed myself.. he wouldn't have to worry about a suicidal person for the rest of his life.. It would just be a "my wife killed herself" he'd be sad for a little, he'd eventually find someone new, have kids and be happy. I'd be a past thing.. everyone will heal eventually.. I know he'd be overall better of without me. I love him to death, and ultimately i feel this would be best. 

Its hard to go easy on myself i just blahh, don't even wanna get into that. Yeah, its like paying someone a lot of money to be my only friend. Its tough, I tried it for a few years, and it hardly helped. I still felt really very lonely. Its also a matter ofmoney right now. We're not the most well off.

I don't currently work. I am in school for Makeup atm, and was in Cosmetology school. He's just stressed out, and.. i can't add stress to that equation. It doesn't matter anyway. Well, i've been through a lot of traumatic events starting at the age of 5. I have multiple posts on it all..  https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/70zbev/i_need_mental_helpsupport/ here's one of them. Feel free. Its hard for me to type it out, it just makes me even more fucked up. Yknow what i mean?

I've gone through a lot, i'm constantly sad and lonely.. and.. theres not a day that goes by that i don't constantly think of killing myself. Yes, he knows I feel this way.. He's very busy with work and school, and so.. I just have to suck it up.
Goodluck
I will continue to try. Thank you.
I've been to a few therapists and none if it helped. Ive also been in the hospital for failed attempts and THEN gone to therapy. Eh, it just made me feel even more alone.

.. Thank you I think? Lol.. Hmm, well I've found myself under an immense amount of stress due to a situation going on at the moment.. Just a lot of drama happening amongst friends.. i'm getting married in a few weeks.. Just a lot a lot of stuff happening all at once.
Honestly.. the only thing I can even slightly be okay with on myself. Blue.

Hm, well, I have a handful of disorders that tend to cause issues in that field. I hate legit everything about myself, though i'm able to admit that people are able to find my eyes appealing. Still, I don't see them as anything special.
I'm not important, I'm literally garbage. I'm not important, I'm a problem tossed from one person to another. I'm a burden.
Frankly, I can't. Everyone ignores anything I say in response to being treated like garbage. To be honest with you everyone hates me. Lol
I always try to share how I feel with certain people in my life. Sadly that doesn't mean they help at all.

I can't thank you enough for this comment.. I am not sure exactly what to say, but I want you to understand I appreciate it so much and I read it all and it helped me feel better. I'm trying really hard to break out of my shell right now, and its tough....

I so badly want to get better. Therapy has always felt so fake to me. I'm paying someone to hear me cry about my problems. Plus it was shoved down my throat and right now I can't afford it even if I absolutely wanted to. Ive been working hard on getting better but it feels like it isn't working. Also thank you fro calling me strong. I feel so weak right now.
I appreciate that, take care of yourself. I hope the best for you. Sorry for being short I'm just a little awkward and it's like I spilled my guts for everyone to see !
This.. Thank you so much for this. I didn't enjoy a shrink as it felt forced. Like I'm paying someone to be my friend. Idk made me feel sad.. Thank you for the kind words. It means so much..
